# Bench: the jeweller's bench top, 9 x 6.4 m of dark planks (textures/planks.png), top at world
# y -0.04. Only the top face: the bench is seen from above and everything below it is hidden.
# Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Planks --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material texture Planks base-color textures/planks.png
add mesh cube --name Bench --size 1 --location 0.1 0.2 -0.14
scale 9 6.4 0.2
apply --scale
material assign Planks
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < 0.9"
delete only-faces
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
shade flat
export bench.glb
